Review: The Silent Echo
Available now at the University Bookstore, Jaden Park’s
novel introduces Ben, a man burdened by regret who
seeks refuge in nature.
Descriptions of the landscape reflect Ben’s complex
inner life as revealed through the diary he keeps.
Recommended if you prefer character development to
action-packed plots.
